probe_source:
"""Variants of `make latency` (src.eval.latency.measure, #81): which part of /api/search p50/p95 is discovery,
and what a text-only query (no OKPD2 — what a customer types into the UI) costs.

usage: latency_variants.py <variant: asis|nodisc|text> <n>     (DATA_STORE from the environment, DISCOVERY_OFFLINE=1)
  asis   — measure() unchanged (dev queries with OKPD2; discovery runs, offline, empty source cache)
  nodisc — the same, src.api.app._discovered returns [] (history block only)
  noenrich — (commit 4162c2c and later) src.api.app._enriched returns the history unchanged
  text   — dev queries with okpd2=[] (a customer who typed only the item name); discovery runs (no OKPD2 -> empty block)
"""
import json, sys
from src.eval import latency
variant, n = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2])
if variant == "nodisc":
    from src.api import app as app_mod
    app_mod._discovered = lambda query, history: []
elif variant == "noenrich":
    from src.api import app as app_mod
    app_mod._enriched = lambda history, uncached: history
elif variant == "text":
    orig = latency.load_cases
    def stripped(part, cfg=None):
        cases = orig(part, cfg)
        for c in cases:
            c.query = c.query.model_copy(update={"okpd2": []})
        return cases
    latency.load_cases = stripped
body = latency.measure(n)
body.pop("per_query")
print(json.dumps({"variant": variant, **body}, ensure_ascii=False))
